manifest.name: dsh-plugin-security-review
manifest.description: Security review gate for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins: static pre-install vetting of malicious code, vulnerabilities and supply-chain risks (with deobfuscation decoding), runtime audit, optional tool-call guard, and a one-click review/install/uninstall panel that works in both the web GUI and the dsh desktop client.

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-security-review bundle patch: inserts the review gate row into
# the profile plugin roster. Install the package into a dsh profile and it
# joins the layer stack automatically:
#
#   dsh-safe-plugin add dsh-plugin-security-review     (reviewed install)
#   dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-security-review
#   dsh.cmd plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-security-review   (桌面客户端)
#
# The single row mounts the host half only (import gate, boot audit, agent
# tools, settings section). The companion CLI `dsh-safe-plugin` performs the
# deterministic pre-install review.
- insert:
    - id: security-review
      name: 'dsh-plugin-security-review'

readme.text:
[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

**简体中文** ｜ [English](./README.en.md)

> **DSH 插件安全审查门**：安装前静态审查（危险代码、漏洞与供应链风险，含反混淆解码）、运行期持续审计与可选运行时守卫，以及设置页一键审查/安装/卸载的可视化面板。

> 🖥️ **已适配 dsh 桌面客户端**（Electron + 内置 0.2.x 运行时，`desktop` profile）：装进 `desktop` profile 即可在桌面设置里看到同一个「插件安全审查」分区；安装/卸载走客户端内建插件管理器，`install-gate` 在打包运行时不可用（只读）。差异详见 [桌面客户端适配记录](docs/2026-10-21-桌面客户端适配.md)。

> 📖 完整使用说明：[docs/使用说明.md](./docs/使用说明.md) ｜ English: [README.en.md](./README.en.md) ｜ [User guide](./docs/USER_GUIDE.en.md)
面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的**插件安全审查插件**：安装本插件后，再安装任何其他插件前，先对该插件的源代码做静态安全审查，识别危险代码、漏洞与供应链风险，输出安全审查报告并给出安装建议；运行期还会持续审计已安装插件，拦截并禁用危险插件。

| 环境 | 运行时 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| web 版 dsh | 0.1.x 运行时 | ✅ 原有行为不变 |
| dsh 桌面客户端 | 0.2.x（打包在 `app.asar`） | ✅ 已适配（`desktop` profile） |

| 层 | 时机 | 能力 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. 安装预审 | 安装前（`dsh-safe-plugin add`） | 下载源码（**不执行任何安装脚本**），静态分析后给出结论；`block` 直接拒绝安装，`warn` 需人工确认，`pass` 才转发给 `dsh plugin add --ignore-scripts` |
| 2. 运行期门禁 | dsh 启动后 | 对 profile 中所有外部插件逐一审查（带缓存）；`block` 的插件被 `loader.update(id,{disabled:true})` 禁用，并把 `disabled: true` 写入 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 托管拦截块，**下次启动时其代码根本不会被 import**；可选运行时守卫拦截危险工具调用 |
| 3. 会话内工具 | 会话进行中 | `security_review` / `security_review_status` 两个工具，可随时审查任意插件/目录并读取历史报告 |
| 3.5 增强分析 | 审查时 | 反混淆解码（base64/hex/fromCharCode/\\xNN 解码后重扫密钥/命令/URL）+ 词法剥离重扫（消除字符串/注释误报，捕捉动态拼接调用） |
```sh

readme.section: 方式一：经本插件自带的安全安装器（推荐）
readme.text: dsh-safe-plugin add github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review

readme.section: 方式二：官方安装命令（安装后同样立即生效）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review
```

安装后，`dsh.plugin` 会自动把本包加入 `dsh.profile.bundles` 层栈（本包声明了 `dsh.bundle`），无需手工改配置。

readme.section: 让 agent 安装（会话内）
readme.text:
不自己敲命令也行，直接在会话里让 agent 装：

> 帮我把 `github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review` 装进当前 profile（桌面端装进 `desktop`）。

agent 走 dsh 的 `plugin_manager` 工具（`install_bundle`；桌面端由同一个内建插件管理器执行，等价于「设置 → 插件」里的安装）：

readme.section: 让 agent 安装（会话内）
readme.text:
- 该工具默认只在 **Creator（Cordis）模式** 启用；Standard / PTC / 极简模式下 agent 会改用终端执行 `dsh plugin … add`（web）或桌面 `dsh.cmd … add`，效果相同。0.1.x 的 web 版没有这个工具，一律走终端。
- 调用要求会话是**完全权限（danger-full-access）**，或对这一次调用单独批准。
- 如果包带有安装/构建脚本，agent 会先把待批准的包名列给你（`pendingBuilds`），你同意后它才会带 `approvedBuilds` 重试。
- 装完通常要重启 dsh（或等 HMR 热加载）才完全生效。

> 让 agent 装插件等于让它下载并运行第三方代码；装之前建议先跑一遍审查：`dsh-safe-plugin review <目标>`，或装好本插件后用设置页里的「审查 / 安全安装」。

桌面客户端把运行时打包进 `app.asar`，profile 固定叫 `desktop`，安装/卸载应交给内置插件管理器：

```powershell

readme.section: 用桌面自带 CLI（路径按实际安装位置调整）
readme.text:
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
    plugin --profile desktop add github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review
```

也可以在桌面「设置 → 插件」里安装。安装后重启客户端（或等 HMR 热加载）。桌面端差异：
install-gate 不可用（运行时只读）、安装/卸载走内置 `pluginManager`、策略在本插件自己的设置分区
编辑。详见 [桌面客户端适配记录](docs/2026-10-21-桌面客户端适配.md)。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-security-review
```
```sh

readme.section: 审查 + 安装（block 直接拒绝；warn 需要交互确认，CI 中用 --yes）
readme.text:
dsh-safe-plugin add dsh-plugin-foo
dsh-safe-plugin add ./local-plugin-dir
dsh-safe-plugin add https://github.com/me/plugin.git

readme.section: 只审查不安装（--ignore 可跳过夹具/第三方目录，可重复）
readme.text:
dsh-safe-plugin review dsh-plugin-foo
dsh-safe-plugin review ./local-plugin-dir --json
dsh-safe-plugin review . --ignore test/fixtures --ignore dist

readme.section: 查看历史报告 / 复审已安装插件
readme.text:
dsh-safe-plugin list
dsh-safe-plugin verify
```

- 每份报告：安全评分（0-100）、`pass / warn / block / audit` 结论、逐条发现（级别、类别、文件:行、代码片段、建议）、安装建议与推荐命令。
- 报告持久化在 `$DSH_HOME/security-review/`：`reports/latest/<包名>.md` 为最新 Markdown 报告，`reports/history/` 为 JSON 历史，`index.json` 为索引。
- Web GUI：
  - 设置页左侧栏新增「**插件安全审查**」模块：展示当前全部已加载插件（官方内置插件灰显、无需审查），每个插件带彩色风险圆点（🟢安全 / 🟡有风险 / 🔴危险）与一句话风险提炼；「一键安全审查」按钮对全部插件执行完整静态审查；非官方插件提供「卸载」按钮（走 pnpm remove，重启后完全生效）。
  - 设置页「security-review」配置区可调审查策略（`standard / strict / audit-only`）、自动禁用开关、allowlist、installGate。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `policy` | `standard` | `standard`：critical→block；`strict`：high 也 block；`audit-only`：只记录不拦截 |
| `autoDisable` | `false` | **默认只报告不自动禁用**（稳定性优先：防止误伤合法插件或在运行中卸载服务导致 dsh 崩溃）；显式开启后，审计发现 block 才会禁用该插件 |
| `autoPatchProfile` | `false` | 默认不写 profile `cordis.patch.yml` 托管块；显式开启后，被拦截插件下次启动不再加载其代码 |
| `installGate` | `false` | **方案 B 改良版**：开启后只在缺失/失效时注入（不反复重写）、原子写入 + node --check 语法自检（失败即回滚）、插件不可用时自清理、另有 `dsh-safe-plugin install-gate/uninstall-gate` 手动管理。默认关闭，安装预审推荐 `dsh-safe-plugin add` |
| `runtimeGuard` | `off` | **运行时工具调用守卫**：`off` 不启用；`log` 检测到危险工具调用（破坏性命令/下载执行/SSRF/敏感凭据文件/提示词注入）只记录日志；`block` 直接拒绝危险调用（fail-open，内部异常一律放行） |
| `allowlist` | `[]` | 豁免名单（包名，`*` 表示全部豁免） |

readme.section: 审查规则（节选，见 docs/design.md 与 lib/analyzer/rules.js）
readme.text:
- **critical**：安装生命周期脚本（preinstall/install/postinstall）、curl|wget 下载后管道执行、child_process 动态拼接/shell:true、eval/new Function 动态执行、远程动态 import、凭据+联网外传、硬编码 API key/Webhook、tarball 完整性校验失败。
- **high**：任何 child_process 调用、原生二进制（.node/.exe/.dll）、node-gyp 构建、原型污染、混淆特征（atob/fromCharCode/长 base64）、ctx.loader 控制面、包名近似知名包（typosquat）、可疑依赖。
- **medium/low**：明文 HTTP、包目录外文件写入、rm -rf、挖矿地址、缺 license/仓库/作者、压缩无源码等。

1. 静态分析无法覆盖原生二进制、动态下载的代码与高度混淆的载荷；block 结论是「存在强风险信号」，不是「证明恶意」。
2. 运行期门禁在本插件自身 `apply` 之后的插件 import 才有**确定性**拦截能力；同批次更早启动的插件在首次启动的毫秒级窗口内会先加载，随后被启动审计禁用，并被托管块保证下次启动不再加载。要获得确定性的安装前拦截，请使用 `dsh-safe-plugin add`。
3. 若某个被拦截插件是其他插件 `inject` 的服务提供方，禁用后启动会因缺服务而失败（这是 dsh 的 fail-loud 契约），报告会指出缺哪个服务。
4. 传递依赖（插件声明的第三方依赖）不在逐文件扫描范围内，只做名称层面的可疑检测；供应链深水区建议配合 lockfile 审计与 registry 信誉。
5. 本插件自身把「审查器运行失败」降级为 `warn`（fail-open），避免审查器自身故障瘫痪整个 dsh；可用 `dsh-safe-plugin verify` 手动复查。

```
lib/
  index.js            宿主插件（审计、设置区、agent 工具、webServer API 注册、watcher）
  api.js              HTTP API（list/run/review/install/uninstall/settings/capabilities/gate，loopback 防护）
  client.js           浏览器端设置页模块（ModuleLoader bundle，策略面板 + 环境提示）

[简体中文](./README.md) ｜ **English**

> **Security review gate for dsh plugins** — static pre-install vetting of malicious code, vulnerabilities and supply-chain risks (with deobfuscation decoding), runtime audit, optional tool-call guard, and a one-click review/install/uninstall panel.

**Runs in both the web GUI and the dsh desktop client** (`desktop` profile, dsh 0.2.x runtime bundled in Electron's `app.asar`). Desktop differences — built-in plugin-manager installs, no `install-gate`, policy stored by the plugin itself — are documented in [the desktop adaptation notes](docs/2026-10-21-桌面客户端适配.md).

A security review plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins. Once installed, every
other plugin is statically reviewed before it is installed or loaded: dangerous code,
vulnerabilities, and supply-chain risks are analyzed, a review report is produced,
and an install recommendation is given. At runtime it keeps auditing the installed
roster and disables dangerous plugins.

See [README.md](./README.md) for the Chinese quick start (the repository's default README).

**Full user guides**:
- English: [docs/USER_GUIDE.en.md](./docs/USER_GUIDE.en.md)
- 中文（简体）: [docs/使用说明.md](./docs/使用说明.md)

| Layer | When | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Install gate | before install (`dsh-safe-plugin add`) | downloads source **without running any install scripts**, analyzes it, prints the report; `block` refuses the install, `warn` needs confirmation, `pass` forwards to `dsh plugin add --ignore-scripts` |
| 2. Runtime gate | after dsh boots | audits every out-of-tree plugin in the profile (cached); `block`ed plugins are disabled via `loader.update(id,{disabled:true})` and written into a managed `disabled: true` block in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, so their code is never imported on the next boot |
| 3. In-session tools | during sessions | `security_review` / `security_review_status` tools review any plugin/source directory and read historical reports |
```sh

readme.section: From GitHub (recommended; the repo is cloned automatically)
readme.text: dsh-safe-plugin add github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review

readme.section: or: dsh plugin --profile web add github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review
readme.text:
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so the dsh plugin manager joins it into
`dsh.profile.bundles` automatically.

You can also ask an agent inside a session instead of running the command yourself:

> Install `github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review` into the current profile (on the desktop client: the `desktop` profile).

The agent uses dsh's `plugin_manager` tool (`install_bundle`; the desktop client
executes it through the same built-in plugin manager as **Settings → Plugins**):

- The tool is enabled only in **Creator (Cordis) mode**; in Standard / PTC / Minimal
  the agent falls back to running `dsh plugin … add` (web) or the desktop
  `dsh.cmd … add`, which has the same effect. The 0.1.x web runtime has no such
  tool, so there the agent always uses the terminal.
- The call requires **full access (danger-full-access)** or a per-call approval.
- If the package has install/build scripts, the agent first shows you the package
  names awaiting approval (`pendingBuilds`) and retries with `approvedBuilds`
  only after you agree.
- Restart dsh (or wait for HMR) for the plugin to take full effect.

> Letting an agent install a plugin means letting it download and run third-party
> code. Review it first with `dsh-safe-plugin review <target>`, or use the
> "Review / safe install" panel of this plugin once it is installed.

The desktop client ships its runtime inside `app.asar`, uses the `desktop`
profile, and expects bundle operations to go through its built-in plugin
manager. Install it with the bundled CLI (adjust the path to your install):

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
    plugin --profile desktop add github:ateen18/dsh-plugin-security-review
```

Then restart the client (or let HMR hot-load it). Desktop differences:
install-gate is unavailable (the runtime is read-only), install/uninstall go
through the built-in `pluginManager`, and the policy is edited in this
plugin's own settings section. See
[the desktop adaptation notes](docs/2026-10-21-桌面客户端适配.md).

```sh
dsh-safe-plugin add dsh-plugin-foo       # review + install
dsh-safe-plugin add ./local-plugin-dir
dsh-safe-plugin add https://github.com/me/plugin.git
dsh-safe-plugin review dsh-plugin-foo   # review only

- Score (0-100), verdict `pass / warn / block / audit`, per-finding detail
  (severity, category, file:line, snippet, recommendation) and an install
  recommendation.
- Persisted under `$DSH_HOME/security-review/`: `reports/latest/<name>.md`
  (markdown), `reports/history/*.json`, `index.json`.
- The web settings UI gains a `security-review` section (policy,
  auto-disable switch, allowlist).

1. Static analysis cannot cover native binaries, runtime-downloaded code, or
   heavily obfuscated payloads; `block` means strong risk signals, not proof
   of malice.
2. The runtime gate deterministically blocks plugin imports that happen after
   this plugin applies; plugins that start earlier in the same boot batch
   load for a few milliseconds before the boot audit disables them, and the
   managed patch block keeps them from loading on the next boot. Use
   `dsh-safe-plugin add` for deterministic pre-install blocking.
3. Blocking a plugin that provides services other rows `inject` fails boot
   loudly with the missing service named — that is dsh's fail-loud contract.
4. Transitive dependencies are checked by name heuristics only (no full
   source scan of the whole dependency tree).
5. A review-engine failure degrades to `warn` (fail-open) so the reviewer
   itself can never brick dsh; re-check with `dsh-safe-plugin verify`.

```sh
npm test      # analyzer unit tests (no dsh needed; run from this dir)
```
